content.title: Aaron Judge | USA Baseball
content.text: Will make his Team USA at the 2026 World Baseball Classic ... Named Captain of Team USA on April 14, 2025 ... 2017 AL Rookie of the Year, three-time AL MVP (2022, 2024, 2025) ... Made MLB debut in 2016 before first full season in 2017, when he hit an AL-leading 52 home runs, drove in 114 runs, and made his first All-Star Game appearance ... Named All-Star in 2018, cranking 27 home runs ... Earned his second Silver Slugger Award with a 39-home run season in 2021 ... Set the AL home run record with 62 blasts in 2022, surpassing Roger Maris' 61 homers in 1961, to earn AL MVP honors ... Hit 37 home runs in 106 games in 2023 ... Posted a career-high 1.159 OPS and led the league with 58 homers and 144 RBIs to take home AL MVP honors for second time in 2024 ... Won AL MVP after leading all of baseball in average (.331), OBP (.457), and SLG (.688) in 2025, also hitting 53 home runs and driving in 114 runs and appearing in his fifth consecutive All-Star Game. AWARDS3x AL MVP (2022, 2024, 2025)7x All Star (2017-2018, 2021-2025)4x All-MLB First Team (2021, 2022, 2024, 2025)5x Silver Slugger Award (2017, 2021, 2022, 2024, 2025)Roberto Clemente Award (2023)AL Rookie of the Year (2017)
